# ⚠️ Risk assessment

## Scope
Change/system, assessment date, assessor, and decision owner.

## Risk method
Explain qualitative or quantitative scales used. Do not mix scales without explanation.

## Risk register
| ID | Threat/uncertainty | Likelihood | Impact | Existing control | Residual rating | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | | | | |

## Mitigation plan
List action, owner, due date, and evidence required to close each risk.

## Accepted risks
Identify who accepted the residual risk and under what conditions.

## Review triggers
New data classes, external services, authentication, hosting, dependency changes, or incidents.
